description: This PHP source file defines the 'jsLanguage' class responsible for generating JavaScript language files for the SuiteCRM application, including methods to create cached strings for application-wide and module-specific language labels.

classes.name: jsLanguage
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate and cache JavaScript language files for applications and modules in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for jsLanguage class; currently empty.

methods.name: createAppStringsCache
methods.description: Creates and caches JavaScript files containing application-wide language strings in specified language.

methods.name: createModuleStringsCache
methods.description: Creates and caches JavaScript language files for a specific module, optionally returning the generated string.
